questions.question: What is the duration of the monsoon in India? भारत में मानसून की अवधि कितनी है?
questions.solution:
The monsoon season in India lasts for 100-120 days, typically from June to September.

• Southwest Monsoon: June to September (Major rainfall period)

• Northeast Monsoon: October to December (Rainfall in Tamil Nadu and coastal Andhra Pradesh)

• The monsoon retreat begins in September and ends in early October.

Article 1 of the Indian Constitution states:

"India, that is Bharat, shall be a Union of States."

• The term "Union of States" was chosen by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar to emphasize that states cannot secede from the Union.

• Unlike a federation, where states have the right to withdraw, India is a "union", meaning states have no such right.

questions.question: The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error. Two of the world's / best forwards / has played alongside / David Beckham.

Two of the world's / best forwards / has played alongside / David Beckham.
questions.solution:

• The correct sentence is:

"Two of the world's best forwards have played alongside David Beckham."

Thus, Option 4 contains the grammatical error.

questions.question: Identify the error in the following sentence. Ourselves should not boast of one's knowledge.
questions.questionHtml:

Ourselves should not boast of one's knowledge.
questions.solution:

• The correct sentence:

"We should not boast of one's knowledge."

Thus, Option 3 (Ourselves) is incorrect.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. This book giving us much information about our freedom fighters who lost their lives while serving our motherland.

This book giving us much information about our freedom fighters who lost their lives while serving our motherland.
questions.solution:
gives us much information

• "Much information" is correct, as "information" is an uncountable noun (not "many information").

Thus, the correct sentence is: "This book gives us much information about our freedom fighters."

Thus, Option 4 is correct.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. I have booked an apartment in the new residential colony.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

I have booked an apartment in the new residential colony.

options.text: An apartment have been booked by me in the new residential colony.
options.html: An apartment have been booked by me in the new residential colony.

options.text: An apartment had been booked by me in the new residential colony.
options.html: An apartment had been booked by me in the new residential colony.

options.text: An apartment is been booked by me in the new residential colony.
options.html: An apartment is been booked by me in the new residential colony.

options.text: An apartment has been booked by me in the new residential colony.
options.html: An apartment has been booked by me in the new residential colony.

questions.solution:
• Active voice: I (subject) have booked (verb) an apartment (object).

• Passive voice: An apartment (object) has been booked (correct verb form) by me (agent).

• Option 1 (have been booked) is incorrect because "apartment" is singular.

• Option 2 (had been booked) is incorrect as it changes the tense to past perfect.

• Option 3 (is been booked) is grammatically incorrect.

Thus, Option 4 is correct.

Thus, Option 3 (Nurture) is correct.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. The teenager delivered the speech.

options.text: The speech has been delivered by the teenager.

options.text: The speech is delivered by the teenager.
options.html: The speech is delivered by the teenager.

options.text: The speech was delivered by the teenager.
options.html: The speech was delivered by the teenager.

options.text: The speech was being delivered by the teenager.
options.html: The speech was being delivered by the teenager.

questions.solution:
• Active voice: The teenager (subject) delivered (verb) the speech (object).

• Passive voice: The speech (object) was delivered (past tense) by the teenager (agent).

• Option 1 (has been delivered) is incorrect as it changes the tense to present perfect.

• Option 2 (is delivered) is incorrect as it changes the tense to simple present.

• Option 4 (was being delivered) changes the tense to past continuous, which is incorrect.

Thus, Option 3 is correct.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
